title: MechanicDB: OBD-II Diagnostic & Repair Database
subtitle: Automotive OBD-II trouble codes with ranked repair procedures & cost estimates
description:
# MechanicDB: OBD-II Diagnostic & Repair Database

> **Full dataset:** [mechanicdb.dataengineered.io](https://mechanicdb.dataengineered.io/) · **$49 Standard (SAE) · $149 OEM Complete**, one-time → [Buy Standard](https://buy.stripe.com/5kQ3cw7Be9b88rNfuU38403) · [Buy OEM Complete](https://buy.stripe.com/28EfZicVy0ECdM796w38404) · the same sample on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Ichlibitiche/mechanicdb-obd2-repair-sample)
Relational database mapping 15,886 OBD-II trouble codes — 9,249 SAE-standard plus 6,637 manufacturer-specific across 32 makes — to 56,729 ranked repair procedures across 647 authored fault families, with DIY difficulty ratings, cost estimates and 75,055 parts mappings (a mapping can also name a tool, a scan or programming session, or a rental). This free Kaggle release contains a 90-code curated sample (75 SAE + 15 OEM).

## Provenance & Methodology

Code definitions are compiled from public SAE J2012-derived sources (MIT-licensed compilation, attribution preserved); repair procedures, DIY difficulty ratings, and cost ranges are original authored content grounded in standard diagnostic practice. Every release is built by a deterministic, test-gated pipeline (anti-template uniqueness checks, referential integrity, no-fabricated-codes gate). The supported legacy-named probability_rank is the authored procedure consideration order within a code, not measured cause likelihood, repair success, severity, urgency, or minimum cost. Execution depends on each procedure's prerequisites and diagnostic findings; see ordering_metadata.json.

The prepared stable-ID sample includes identity_metadata.json and filtered identity_map.csv/.parquet. IDs are scoped by domain/entity and independent of display rank; historical numbers require exact artifact context.

Sample source, full documentation, and data dictionary: https://github.com/MechanicDB/MechanicDB-public - the full commercial dataset (15,886 codes) is available under license; see the repository README.

resources.description: Master registry of standardized SAE-universal and manufacturer-specific (OEM) Diagnostic Trouble Codes.

fields.name: code_id
fields.description: Primary key identifier for the trouble code record.

fields.name: dtc_code
fields.description: Standardized 5-character OBD-II trouble code (e.g., P0171, P0300, P0420).

fields.name: system_category
fields.description: Automotive system classification (Powertrain, Chassis, Body, Network).

fields.name: is_oem_specific
fields.description: Boolean flag: 0 = SAE-universal, 1 = manufacturer-specific.

fields.name: oem_make
fields.description: Manufacturer display name for OEM rows (e.g., Ford, Chevrolet, BMW); empty for SAE-universal rows.

fields.name: fault_family
fields.description: Slug of the authored fault family this code belongs to (groups codes sharing a diagnosis and repair path).

fields.name: short_description
fields.description: Concise summary of the diagnostic trouble code.

fields.name: detailed_technical_explanation
fields.description: In-depth technical explanation of what the engine control module detects.

resources.description: Ranked repair procedures and cost estimation matrices for trouble codes.

fields.name: fix_id
fields.description: Primary key identifier for the repair procedure.

fields.name: code_id
fields.description: Foreign key referencing dtc_codes.code_id.

fields.name: fix_title
fields.description: Actionable title of the recommended diagnostic inspection or repair.

fields.name: probability_rank
fields.description: Authored procedure consideration order within a code (1 = first); conditional on prerequisites and findings, not measured likelihood or outcome.

fields.name: difficulty_level
fields.description: Skill requirement rating (Easy DIY, Moderate DIY, Professional Required).

fields.name: est_parts_cost_min_usd
fields.description: Estimated minimum aftermarket parts cost in US dollars; empty when parts_cost_status is unknown, 0 when none_required.

fields.name: est_parts_cost_max_usd
fields.description: Estimated maximum aftermarket parts cost in US dollars; empty when parts_cost_status is unknown, 0 when none_required.

fields.name: est_labor_hours
fields.description: Editorial estimate of professional labor hours; empty when labor_status is unknown.

fields.name: step_by_step_instructions
fields.description: Bulleted step-by-step diagnostic and repair instructions.

fields.name: action_type
fields.description: Procedure action: inspect, measure, scan, repair, replace, program or verify; empty when not yet classified.

fields.name: parts_cost_status
fields.description: estimated, none_required (no parts; costs 0) or unknown (costs empty).

fields.name: labor_status
fields.description: estimated or unknown (labor empty).

fields.name: cost_basis_id
fields.description: Key into cost_metadata.json: currency, geography and editorial basis of the estimates.

fields.name: procedure_rationale
fields.description: Why this step, why its cost status and why its position; empty when not yet written.

resources.description: Parts and supplies mapped to diagnostic fixes, with catalog search URLs; a row can also name a tool, a scan or programming session, or a rental.

fields.name: part_id
fields.description: Primary key identifier for the replacement part.

fields.name: fix_id
fields.description: Foreign key referencing diagnostic_fixes.fix_id.

fields.name: part_name
fields.description: Name or description of the part, kit or supply; it can also name a tool, a scan or programming session, or a rental.

fields.name: amazon_search_query
fields.description: Direct search URL for the named item on Amazon or auto parts catalogs.
